scenarios.answer: Our return policy allows products to be returned if they are undamaged and complete. You can try the product, but items with signs of use are not accepted. You only need the order number for a return; an invoice is not required. Returns must be requested within 30 days from the delivery date; after 30 days, returns are not accepted and the product will be evaluated under warranty. If you use our contracted carrier Anadolu Kargo for the return, the shipping is free by showing the return code at the branch. If you use your own carrier, the shipping cost will not be refunded. Once the product reaches our warehouse and passes inspection, the refund will be processed within 5 business days to the original payment method. For cash on delivery orders, refunds are made to the account holder's IBAN. Some products cannot be returned, including opened in-ear headphones, personal care products, opened software packages, and custom-made products [İade Politikası:Genel Koşullar] [İade Politikası:İade Süresi] [İade Politikası:İade Kargo Ücreti] [İade Politikası:Geri Ödeme Süresi] [İade Politikası:İade Edilemeyen Ürünler].
